name: Mitchell Allen
bio: Mitchell runs The Box. He came from museums and after-school programs, including a Boys & Girls Club summer at the Burien Community Center; 3D printers and shop machines were his hobby first. His job, as he puts it, is to be the catalyst — get members to his level on a tool, then point them at the people who have gone further.

name: Denise Ferguson
bio: Denise helped stand the shop up: equipment, work areas by craft, the floor you walk today. She is a long-time Discover Burien employee and Burien small-business owner, with more than twenty years in e-commerce and entrepreneurship — experience she still teaches and mentors from. Her dad was a woodworker; when Debra asked her to help build a makerspace, it was already her alley.

name: Debra George
bio: Debra’s idea for The Box came from the Burien Farmers Market: a vendor who could not make enough product to keep up. Discover Burien is a 501(c)(3) founded in 2002; The Box is one of its programs. She still frames the shop as both a launchpad for micro-businesses and a room where anyone can make.

name: Martha Cabello
bio: Martha is part of Discover Burien’s small office team — the people who keep the nonprofit, the calendar, and the shop’s front door moving.

name: Wilson Benjamin
bio: Listed on Discover Burien’s staff page as CCO. Shop morale department. Does not run the laser.

name: Paul Illian
bio: Paul teaches acrylic painting in the shop. Each session is a finished small painting — landscapes, still lifes, animal portraits — with step-by-step guidance so you leave with a piece, not just notes.

name: Wendy
bio: Wendy teaches beginner and intermediate woodworking: bandsaw setup and cuts, chop saw, drill press, glue-ups, sanding, and project classes from cutting boards and charcuterie boards to tool caddies. Class listings publish her as Wendy; last name is not on the public calendar.

name: Matt Swanson
bio: Matt is a printmaker, painter, model maker, and illustrator — a Pacific Northwest native whose work often starts from nature, animals, heavy music, and big nerdy monsters. BFA from DigiPen; more than fourteen years in games. His work has won BAFTA and Peabody awards and is in the Smithsonian and MoMA collections. At The Box he teaches relief printing: transfer an image, carve the block, pull a print.
